verses.text: Ha jun schekab' Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ex anima kajan t'a stitak ha' mar, ab'ek tas ol wala'. Ex anima te najat ayex, maklejek eyab'i: Ha Jehová awtannak in ayik manto in alji. Yalnakkanel in b'i ayik kuchb'il hinto och yuj in nun.

Ha tas swala' lajan icha k'een espada te jay ye, icha chi' ajnakkan yuj Dios. Sk'ub'ejnak in el t'a yalanh sk'ab'. Icha junok jul-lab' te jay snhi', icha chi' yutejnak in, sk'ub'ejnak in t'a yol yet'tal sjul-lab'.
Yalannak t'ayin icha tik: Ach Israel in chekab' ach, uuj ol cheklaj in wach'il, xchi t'ayin.

Palta ix in naani to nab'anhej ix in munlaji. Nab'anhej ix el wip, malaj tas ix wik'a', xin chi. Palta wojtak to chekel yaji tas waj t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha spak in munlajel chi', ayek' t'a yol sk'ab'.

Haxo tiknaik jun, toxo ix in cha sniwanil welk'och t'a yichanh Jehová in Diosal, a tz'ak'an wip. Ayinto ek' t'a yol sk'ol in nun ix snaani to tzin och schekab'ok, yik swik'an meltzaj heb' israel yinhtilal Jacob junelxo t'ay.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: In chekab' ach yik tza tojolb'itanxi heb' yinhtilal Jacob, tzik'anxi meltzaj heb' israel kannakto tik t'ayin. Palta manhoknhej yuj chi' ix ach in sik'kaneli, palta yik tzach wak'och sakilq'uinalil t'a juntzanhxo nakión masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal, yik skolchaj heb' wuuj, xchi t'ayin, xchi jun schekab' chi'.

Ha Jehová Skolumal Israel, Dios Haxonhej Ochi, slolon t'a schekab', haton jun patikab'ileli, yajb'il yuj masanil nakión, chekab' pax yajoch t'a heb' yajal. Syalan icha tik: Ayik ol ach yilan heb' yajal, ol k'e waan heb', ol em nhojan heb' t'a ichanh, yujto a in Jehová sDiosal in Israel, Ha inxonhej Ochi, ix ach in sik'eli, swak'anelk'och tas walnak, xchi Jehová.

Syalan Jehová t'a schekab' icha tik: Ayik ol k'och stiempoal in ch'oxan in wach'k'olal, ol ach in kolo', ol in pakan tas ix a k'an t'ayin. Ol ach in tanhwej, ol ach wak'och yik tzak'anelk'och in trato yet' masanil chonhab', yik sb'ochajxik'e in chonhab', yik tza pojanxiek' smakb'en heb' t'a lum lum kannak tzinan.

Tzin chekan al t'a heb' icha to preso yaj t'a k'ik' k'inal icha tik: Elanhekkan t'a libre, xa chi. Ol ilchaj tastak tz'och yuj heb', icha nok' kalnel yax b'aj stanhwaj wa t'a titak b'e, haxo t'a lum takinh sat, ayxo tas swa nok'.
Manhxo ol yak' wejel heb' yet' takinhtial, manhxo ol yab' syail heb' yuj sk'ak'al yok k'u, yujto a in tzin xajanej heb', ol wik'b'at heb' b'aj ay sjajtak ha ha'.
Ol in jak jun b'e t'a jolomtak witz, te wach' ol aj in b'oan sb'eal in chonhab', xchi Jehová.
Ileknab' skot in chonhab' t'a najat, ay heb' skot t'a norte, ay pax heb' skot b'aj tz'em k'u, ay pax heb' skot t'a yol yik Sinim.

Awajokab' satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik t'a tzalajk'olal. Yet' lum niwak witz elokab' yaw lum yuj tzalajk'olal, yujto a Jehová wan yak'an sniwanil sk'ol schonhab'. Toxo ix ok' sk'ol t'a heb' ayoch t'a syaelal.
Syalan heb' aj Sion icha tik: Ix onh yaktejkan Jehová, ix onh b'atkan satk'olal yuj Kajalil, xchi heb'.
Palta syalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha junok ix nunab'il, ¿tokwal sb'at satk'olal yune' ix yuj? Wach'chom sb'at satk'olal yuj ix jun, palta a in tik manh ol ex b'at satk'olal wuuj.
Ichato tz'ib'ab'il he b'i t'a yol in k'ab', yuj chi' naan exnhej wuuj.
Elanhchamel ol b'ochajxik'e smuroal he chonhab', haxo heb' ajk'ol pojjinakemi, heb' satannakeli, wanxo yel heb'.

Ex aj Sion, ileknab' t'a he patik eyichanh, a heb' ik'b'ilb'at t'a ch'ok nakional, wan smolb'anxi sb'a heb' yik sjax heb' heyet'ok. Ha in Jehová in tzin lok in b'i swalani to ol eyik'chaanh he b'a yuj heb' eyetchonhab' chi'. Icha wal stzalaj junok ix kob'es yuj yelwanub' spichul ayik snupnaji, icha chi' ol aj he tzalaj yuj heb' wan sjax chi'.
Yujto a he chonhab' tik mak'b'ilkanem lanhnajok, kuseltak yajkani. Haxo tiknaik, manhxo ol yab'laj lum skajan heb' anima chi'. Ha heb' mak'jinakkanem lanhnaj chi', najatxo ay heb'.
Ha heb' yuninal heb' aljinak t'a ch'ok nakional chi', ol yal heb' t'ayex icha tik: Te jab'nhej jun lum lum tik t'ayonh, aq'ek ko lu'um b'aj tzonh kajnaji, xcham heb'.

Ol he naan icha tik: ¿Mach ay yuninal juntzanh heb' tik? Ha onh tik manhxalaj kuninal. Maxtzak yalpaxlaj yalji heb', ik'b'il onh b'at t'a jun ch'ok nakional, chakb'il onh eli. ¿Mach ix ilan q'uib' heb' kuninal tik? ¿B'ajtil ix kot heb'? xe chama.
Ha in Jehová Eyajal in ol wal t'a juntzanhxo nakión, ol wik'anpaxchaanh in bandera yil heb', yik ol ik'jokkot heb' eyuninal chi' yuj heb', ol ul ak'jokkan heb'.

Ha heb' yajal, icha he mam ol aj heb', haxo heb' ix yetb'eyum heb', icha he nun ol aj heb' ix. Ol em nhojan heb' yajal chi' t'a sat lu'um t'a eyichanh, emnakil ol aj heb' yik tzex yik'anchaanh heb'. Hata' ol nachajel eyuuj to a in Jehová in, a innhej Dios in. Ha heb' tzin ak'anoch yipok sk'ool, manh ol kan heb' t'a q'uixwelal, xchi Jehová.
Ha junok winh winak te ay yip, ¿tzam yal stok'jiek' masanil tas ix yik' winh t'a owal? ¿Tzam yal stok'jikanek' junok presowum t'a junok yajal te ow?

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha t'a heb' te ay yip ol in tok'kanek' heb' presowum. Ha t'a heb' yajal ek'b'al te ow, ol in tok'kanek' tastak ix yik' heb' t'a owal. Yujto a in ol wak' owal yet' heb' eyajk'ol chi', ol in kolan heb' eyetchonhab' chi'.

Ha in ol wak' sk'ulej heb' ix ex ixtan chi', to ol smil-lajcham sb'a heb'. Ol och heb' icha uk'umanhil yuj skot yowal b'aj ol smil-lajcham sb'a chi'. Yuj chi' ol yojtakejel masanil anima to a in ton wal Jehová he Kolumal in. Ha in sDiosal in winhaj Jacob to Syal Wuj Smasanil, xchi Jehová.
